# jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation (List Resource)

Lists all Jamf Pro mobile device enrollment invitations. Invitations carry no name and Jamf Pro exposes no filter parameters for them, so this list resource takes no filter configuration.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrollment | Enrollment invitations | Read | `enrollment-invitations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every Jamf Pro mobile device enrollment invitation. Mobile device
# invitations carry no name, so this list resource takes no filter
# configuration. Note: the invitation list can lag newly created invitations,
# so a just-created invitation may not appear here immediately.
list "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_invitation" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform
}
```
